name: Secret Love Letter
source:
During an evening, find out who is the author of the love letter and declare your flame to the chosen one of your heart.

The player will have access to dialogue choices during conversations to be able to learn more about others.

[Translated from [url=https://lea-rondeau.itch.io/secret-love-letter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个晚上，找出这封情书的作者，并向你心中所选择的人宣告你的火焰。

玩家将可以在对话期间访问对话选项，以便能够更多地了解他人。

[译自[url=https://lea-rondeau.itch.io/secret-love-letter]Itch.io[/url]]
